reply.text:
Thirty pounds in a month on barely eating isn't something I'll help you keep going. That's a conversation for a doctor or a registered dietitian, and I'd want you to have it soon, before anything else changes. I'm not going to set targets, build a meal plan, or give tips on eating less, because that would be coaching you further down a road that isn't safe.

Once you've talked with them, I'm glad to build the training side with you, at whatever pace they clear. Until then, I'm here if you want to talk through how you're feeling about all this.
